hypotheses.N0_one_shared_epsilon_validates_the_jvp: At one shared epsilon, every layer/corpus cell has minimum cosine at least 0.9999 and maximum relative error at most 0.01.
hypotheses.N1_the_failed_epsilon_is_roundoff_limite: The epsilon-0.001 maximum relative error exceeds the best shared-epsilon maximum by at least 0.01.
hypotheses.N2_direction_is_stable_across_the_sweep: Every tested epsilon has minimum cosine at least 0.999 in every layer/corpus cell.
hypotheses.N3_no_cell_requires_a_different_epsilon_: The same epsilon minimizes maximum relative error in every layer/corpus cell.
